title: 柔性产线 · 十年收益实验树

protocol.accounting: J = revenue - actual processing/setup operating cost - all new machine purchase cost. Existing 8 machines are sunk. Zero interest, unconstrained funding; all principal recovered by H required.
protocol.allocation: Project-specific straight-line allocation over [purchase_time,H]; zero residual. Allocation is a presentation ledger, never deducted twice from J.
protocol.regularizer: TV = 0.5*sum(abs(completed_share-final_realized_arrival_share)); J_lambda=J-lambda*TV. Zero completions gives TV=1. Final arrivals are evaluation-only.
protocol.causality: Policy receives frozen JobView and DecisionView only. No seed, future arrivals, true required work, remaining failure life or event queue. Dynamic investment uses past active time and current backlog only.
protocol.search_budget: Initial rules/capacities, <=10 single-station capacity neighbors; 30000-minute development proxies; 120000-minute validation proxies; up to 6 finalists, 3 full 1200000-minute confirmation repetitions each. No globally optimal claim.
limitations: Working-time calendar; no overnight repairs or seasonality.
No debt interest/credit limit, acquisition lead time, demand caps, machine aging or physical replacement.
Prices and operating charges stay at case defaults; no unprovided material/labor/tax costs.
Policies are reviewed fixed rules with typed observations, not adversarial OS-isolated submitted programs.
Short-run proxy selection can miss policies whose merit appears only after long transients.
